limitations: Other avatars not tested
Mesh and clothing clearance approximated by skeleton segments and a torso ellipsoid
Posture limits are conservative juggling workspace constraints, not a complete human biomechanics model
Named techniques are references; the In-line 3 upper 2x variant remains a candidate
Unverified HF variants and reference-table combinations remain explicitly unverified
Multiplex, odd asynchronous and behind-body throws are outside the current sequence grammar
Automatic In-line entry/exit is for normal alternating 4 and 2x; other entry styles remain unverified
Transfer bridges solve arrival schedules in both directions; arbitrary spatial transitions still require collision and rig validation
Changing grip can make a previously valid path collide; the modified Penman held-claw path is rejected and requires a different route
Levels follows the written apex-catch instruction; the public animated diagram catches the outer ball below its peak. Exact human performance timing remains unverified.
The alternate-cross mixed-height connection is verified for its two component cycles. Direct joins from normal Box or to the lower-column both-Inverted layout fail clearance or posture constraints.
HF Crosses notation and motion structure are inferred from sampled author-video frames; exact performance timing, depth and elbow angles are not reconstructed.

HF Under-Arm-Box follows the sampled underarm-release, self-catch and high-transfer structure; exact performance timing, depth and elbow angles are not reconstructed. Its twelve-set Box connection is a validated model-specific example, not a generic spatial transition solver.

HF Reverse-Under-Arm-Box reproduces the sampled rising transfer and underarm self-catch structure, not exact source timing, depth, elbow angles or finger poses. The fixed-role Under-Arm-Box source video failed to load and its motion remains unreviewed.

A one-set import preserves that set motion definition and alternating-cross phase; arbitrary combinations still need complete ball and rig validation. Selecting a single set does not certify it as a standalone cyclic pattern.

HF Under-Arm-Claw-Box and its six-set Box Roll connection pass both mirrored real-rig cycles. The connection returns ball identities after eighteen sets. Other spatial connections are not certified; live UI verification of this addition and the cycle-explanation text remains pending after the browser URL safety policy rejection.

Fixed-role HF Under-Arm-Claw-Box follows eighteen sampled HD video frames and passes both mirrored real-rig cycles. Its (2x,4x) orientation follows the video and reflects the source table notation. Ninety-five connection candidates did not pass; none was registered. Exact source timing/depth and rendered appearance remain unverified.

Connection suggestions match nineteen registered directed source pairs exactly, including expanded repetitions and tempo. They do not solve arbitrary spatial connections, and their UI interactions remain unverified after the browser policy rejection.

HF Double Under-Arm-Claw-Box follows sixteen source-video frames and returns motion and ball identities in four sets. Its central low catches differ from the standalone fixed-role source. Full rig checks pass in both mirrors, while exact source fidelity and current simulator UI remain unverified.

Template start selection preserves the cyclic ball/hand paths in automated tests. Odd implicit alternating-cross cycles need explicit phase definitions, and representations exceeding sixty-four rows are rejected. The new selector and six-set alternating-claw / Double connection remain pending live UI verification.

HF Reverse-Under-Arm-Inverted-Box follows twenty-nine sampled video frames. The symmetric simultaneous-catch implementation and four-set Reverse-UA connection pass both mirrored rig cycles; exact source timing/depth and live simulator UI remain unverified.

Fixed HF Reverse-UAI follows twenty-one sampled HD frames with rounded timing. Its single-set movement returns ball identities after three sets; the normal fixed-Inverted connection returns movement after four and identities after twelve. Both mirrors pass the rig checks, while exact source fidelity and live simulator UI remain unverified.

HF box + box* maps to the unchanged original Double Box after seventeen sampled source frames. It differs spatially from central-column Extended Box. The six-set Box connection passes both mirrored rig cycles; exact source fidelity and current live UI remain unverified.

HF box + inverted-box* uses alternating low/high 2x in a four-set Double cycle, supported by twenty-three source frames. Sixteen generic Double combinations and the six-set Box connection pass mirrored rig checks; exact source fidelity and current live UI remain unverified.

HF Shuffle+Box and Box+Shuffle have different 2x phase assignments and explicit underhand-supported shuffle releases, based on twenty-three and twenty-two source frames. Their eight-set connection passes both mirrored rig checks; exact source fidelity and current live UI remain unverified.

HF Box+Reverse and Reverse+Reverse have distinct rising-2x phase assignments, supported by twenty-four and twenty-three source frames. Both four-set patterns and their eight-set connection pass mirrored rig checks. Exact source palm pitch remains unresolved; automatic catch grips are model policy. Current live UI remains unverified.

The 54 fitted height configurations, 18 spatial routes and 16 basic Double configurations form an 88-source connected network in both mirrors at the tested avatar/tempo. The remaining 42 initial height configurations, source catalog fidelity, arbitrary edits and live current UI still need separate evidence.

The segment graph reuses verified ball/hand tracks and elbow paths. Forty-six component sources register in both mirrors. Twenty-three transition families pass both mirrors at their tested tempos. The 56 valid height combinations, eighteen spatial primitives and sixteen basic Double configurations form an 90-source connected network; thirty mixed closed walks per mirror reuse existing trajectories without arm searches. High-Low-Around connects through High-Low at its separate native tempo. The other 40 initial height combinations and arbitrary edits remain outside this verified network. Current live UI remains unverified.
